instructions.paused: Indicator unreadable. Wait for a readable observation.

view_rule: render instructions[current_state] only; full table is an audit view

unknown_state.allowed_action: recover a known saved state or restart gather; do not infer start

observation_contract.pass: successful check at the current setup
observation_contract.fail: failed check at the current setup
observation_contract.unreadable: no result; neither pass nor fail
observation_contract.setup_changed: return to connect and obtain a new check; old observation invalid
